meaning.vi: Hiện tại phân từ của enfold.
Một sự gấp gáp xung quanh một cái gì đó.

meaning_vi: xếp thành nếp, gấp nếp lại

sentences.en: The mother was enfolding her baby in her arms.

sentences.en: Thack came up behind him, enfolding him in his arms.

sentences.en: We held him between us, enfolding him with our arms as he cried.
